CodeClarity Bench: A Multilingual Code Summarization Benchmark
	




	
		
		Overview
	

CodeClarity Bench is the benchmark component of the CodeClarity Framework, established for rigorous evaluation of code-summarization models across multiple programming and natural languages. It enables standardized, reproducible comparison of summarization capabilities in models trained or fine-tuned for code-understanding tasks.
